news.contents: Following the team's 31-21 loss to the hosting Detroit Lions, Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield (foot) noted that his foot "felt a lot better than it did at Chicago." Mayfield ultimately played and was decent, tossing two scores. That he was able to finish the game bodes well for his status heading into Week 12. ...
